newsitem.title: FRANCE: France Telecom launches corporate Internet service.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom launches corporate Internet service.

text.p: State-owned France Telecom launched on Friday its Global Intranet service which allows companies access to services on the Internet through their own computer systems.
Global Intranet, which was developed by France Telecom as part of the Global One partnership with Deutsche Telekom and Sprint Corp, is offered worldwide through the alliance.
The intranet service includes standard services such as messaging, Web servers as well as new functions such as management of directories and enhanced messaging.
